page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the running head at top and the page number at top right. Below the last line: a gathering signature at left and a catchword at right. No notes in the margins; a handwritten mark and ink underlines are not printed text.

main_text.p: [?]inum patriarchæ Iacob, & ingressus templum, adytum ipsum etiam profanauit? Id uero factum scribitur sub Ciceronis consulatu, ut dictum est, Iosepho etiam teste, anno ante Seruatorem natum 60. Illu 60. annis si adiungas 606. usq; post mortem Gregorii Magni, qui uaticinatus est illum fore Antichristum, qui uniuersalis episcopus haberi vellet, aut omnium Ecclesiarum caput. Circumspi-ce igitur oculis uigilantibus, qualia tempora fuerint anno 666. à capta Hierosolyma per Romanos, duce Pompeio: & stupenda quædam occurrent temporibus Phocæ huius Imperatoris. De quo Guilhelmus Stantphurdius in sua Farragine:

p.i: Suffocat imperium Phocæ, stabilitq; Papatum, Impia per regni, mittendo diplomata fines: Primatum Latij quibus antitheiq; draconis, Fortiter ad cunctam confirmet posteritatem: Et bona quod facies fieri cupit illico præsul: Eduntur toto bullata diplomata regno.

main_text.p: Deinde numerum istum mysticum, plenum sapientia quadam singulari, apta natali Christi, aptæ passioni Dominicæ, apta ei tempori quo Titus cuertit urbem: aut Domitiani 15. anno, quando Apocalypsis scripta est, & semper aliquid monstrorum in Ecclesia offendes. page.notes: The first word of the page is clipped at the top edge; read as "[?]inum" (probably "sinum"). "Illu 60." is printed as such. The "Suffocat" passage is verse, set as one stanza in italic. A handwritten "#" mark stands in the right margin beside "Deinde" and ink underlines run through several lines; these are not printed and are omitted.
